calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
daily AS (
  SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS ns FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       ROUND(x.ns,0) AS mine, ROUND(c.cs,0) AS control
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN daily x ON x.business_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS cs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales GROUP BY 1) c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  AND (d.is_trading_day = false OR d.is_public_holiday OR abs(coalesce(x.ns,0)-coalesce(c.cs,0))>1 OR x.ns IS NULL)
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-01' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

  SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')

UNION ALL SELECT 'web_order_lines_in_nonstore900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>900

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c, MIN(sale_date) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) AS nets, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods,
         COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS qtys, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_ts_utc) AS tss, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MAX(sales_line_id)-MIN(sales_line_id) AS idgap
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT dm.fiscal_year, dm.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(c) AS rows_involved, MAX(c) AS maxc, MAX(nets) AS maxnets, MAX(prods) AS maxprods, MAX(qtys) AS maxqty, MAX(tss) AS maxts, MAX(loads) AS maxloads, MIN(idgap) AS min_idgap, MAX(idgap) AS max_idgap
FROM dups JOIN dim_date dm ON dm.calendar_date = dups.d
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, MIN(r.business_date) AS first_day, MAX(r.business_date) AS last_day, COUNT(*) AS days_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.net_sales_before_returns > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_with_sales, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),0) AS net,
       (SELECT string_agg(c.closure_type || ' ' || CAST(c.closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) || '..' || CAST(c.closure_end_date AS VARCHAR), '; ') FROM ref_store_closure c
         WHERE c.store_id = r.store_id AND c.closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28') AS closures,
       (SELECT string_agg(CAST(s.open_date AS VARCHAR) || '/' || COALESCE(CAST(s.close_date AS VARCHAR),'-'), ',') FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=r.store_id AND s.is_current) AS open_close
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT 'dup_returns' AS k, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS v FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_over_sold', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM (SELECT r.sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY r.sales_line_id, f.quantity HAVING SUM(r.quantity_returned) > MAX(f.quantity))
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_' || CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), store_name || ' | ' || city || ' | ' || region || ' | ' || format || ' | open ' || COALESCE(CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR),'-') || ' | close ' || COALESCE(CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR),'-') FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id IN (125,129,136,137)
UNION ALL SELECT 'refit125_' || CAST(closure_id AS VARCHAR), closure_type || ' ' || CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) || '..' || CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) || ' wks ' || CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id = 125
UNION ALL SELECT 'ty_wk_store125_129', CAST(ROUND(SUM(net_sales),0) AS VARCHAR) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id IN (125,129) AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
